stanzas.sanskrit:
निशमय्य तवाथ यानवार्तां
भृशमार्ताः पशुपालबालिकास्ताः ।
किमिदं किमिदं कथं न्वितीमाः
समवेताः परिदेवितान्यकुर्वन् ॥ ७३-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Gopikas heard the news of Krishna planning to leave to Mathura with Akrurar. They were deeply saddened and lamented as to what was that? How and why it was happening?
stanzas.stanza_roman:
niśamayya tavātha yānavārtāṃ
bhṛśamārtāḥ paśupālabālikāstāḥ |
kimidaṃ kimidaṃ kathaṃ nvitīmāḥ
samavetāḥ paridevitānyakurvan || 73-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
करुणानिधिरेष नन्दसूनुः
कथमस्मान्विसृजेदनन्यनाथाः ।
बत नः किमु दैवमेवमासी-
-दिति तास्त्वद्गतमानसा विलेपुः ॥ ७३-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The Gopikas lamented how can Krishna, the son of Nandagopa who is ocean of mercy leave us as we have no other support. Why did God do this to us. Fixing their minds on Krishna, the Gopikas lamented and cried.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
karuṇānidhireṣa nandasūnuḥ
kathamasmānvisṛjedananyanāthāḥ |
bata naḥ kimu daivamevamāsī-
-diti tāstvadgatamānasā vilepuḥ || 73-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
चरमप्रहरे प्रतिष्ठमानः
सह पित्रा निजमित्रमण्डलैश्च ।
परितापभरं नितम्बिनीनां
शमयिष्यन् व्यमुचः सखायमेकम् ॥ ७३-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna was to leave along with father and friends in the last part of the night. Krishna sent one of HIS companions to console the sad Gopikas.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
caramaprahare pratiṣṭhamānaḥ
saha pitrā nijamitramaṇḍalaiśca |
paritāpabharaṃ nitambinīnāṃ
śamayiṣyan vyamucaḥ sakhāyamekam || 73-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अचिरादुपयामि सन्निधिं वो
भविता साधु मयैव सङ्गमश्रीः ।
अमृताम्बुनिधौ निमज्जयिष्ये
द्रुतमित्याश्वसिता वधूरकार्षीः ॥ ७३-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna sent the word of promise that HE will be back soon and they will have many more meetings with HIM. HE further consoled them by saying that HE will give them more pleasure and drown them in supreme bliss.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
acirādupayāmi sannidhiṃ vo
bhavitā sādhu mayaiva saṅgamaśrīḥ |
amṛtāmbunidhau nimajjayiṣye
drutamityāśvasitā vadhūrakārṣīḥ || 73-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
सविषादभरं सयाच्ञमुच्चै-
-रतिदूरं वनिताभिरीक्ष्यमाणः ।
मृदु तद्दिशि पातयन्नपाङ्गान्
सबलोऽक्रूररथेन निर्गतोऽभूः ॥ ७३-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Gopikas with great sorrow worshipped Krishna and followed him with their eyes for a long distance. Krishna too glanced through the corner of his eyes at the direction of Gopikas and left with Balarama in Akrurar's chariot.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
saviṣādabharaṃ sayācñamuccai-
-ratidūraṃ vanitābhirīkṣyamāṇaḥ |
mṛdu taddiśi pātayannapāṅgān
sabalo’krūrarathena nirgato’bhūḥ || 73-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अनसा बहुलेन वल्लवानां
मनसा चनुगतोऽथ वल्लभानाम् ।
वनमार्तमृगं विषण्णवृक्षं
समतीतो यमुनातटीमयासीः ॥ ७३-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Many Gopas followed the chariot in their own chariots and even Gopikas followed Krishna through their thoughts. Animals and trees in the forest felt very sorrowful. Krishna crossed all these and came to the Yamuna river bank.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
anasā bahulena vallavānāṃ
manasā canugato’tha vallabhānām |
vanamārtamṛgaṃ viṣaṇṇavṛkṣaṃ
samatīto yamunātaṭīmayāsīḥ || 73-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
नियमाय निमज्ज्य वारिणि त्वा-
-मभिवीक्ष्याथ रथेऽपि गान्दिनेयः ।
विवशोऽजनि किन्न्विदं विभोस्ते
ननु चित्रं त्ववलोकनं समन्तात् ॥ ७३-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Akrurar, son of Gandhinee was bathing in the river to do his daily prayers. When he took a dip in water he saw Krishna in the water and when he lifted up from water, saw Krishna seated on the chariot. He became helpless not knowing what it is all about and wondered at the omnipresent swaroopam of Krishna which is seen everywhere and became excited.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
niyamāya nimajjya vāriṇi tvā-
-mabhivīkṣyātha rathe’pi gāndineyaḥ |
vivaśo’jani kinnvidaṃ vibhoste
nanu citraṃ tvavalokanaṃ samantāt || 73-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
पुनरेष निमज्ज्य पुण्यशाली
पुरुषं त्वां परमं भुजङ्गभोगे ।
अरिकम्बुगदाम्बुजैः स्फुरन्तं
सुरसिद्धौघपरीतमालुलोके ॥ ७३-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Akrurar took a dip in the water once again. He saw Bhagwan seated on Adisesha, adorned with the discus, conch, mace and lotus and surrounded by other Devas, siddha purushas and Gods.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
punareṣa nimajjya puṇyaśālī
puruṣaṃ tvāṃ paramaṃ bhujaṅgabhoge |
arikambugadāmbujaiḥ sphurantaṃ
surasiddhaughaparītamāluloke || 73-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
स तदा परमात्मसौख्यसिन्धौ
विनिमग्नः प्रणुवन् प्रकारभेदैः ।
अविलोक्य पुनश्च हर्षसिन्धो-
-रनुवृत्या पुलकावृतो ययौ त्वाम् ॥ ७३-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Immersed in supreme bliss, Akrurar worshipped Krishna in saguna and nirguna forms. Even after the vision disappeared, Akrurar continued to be soaked in the unlimited bliss, experienced goosebumps and came to Krishna seated on the chariot.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
sa tadā paramātmasaukhyasindhau
vinimagnaḥ praṇuvan prakārabhedaiḥ |
avilokya punaśca harṣasindho-
-ranuvṛtyā pulakāvṛto yayau tvām || 73-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
किमु शीतलिमा महान् जले य-
-त्पुलकोऽसाविति चोदितेन तेन ।
अतिहर्षनिरुत्तरेण सार्धं
रथवासी पवनेश पाहि मां त्वम् ॥ ७३-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan asked him if the water was so cold that he had goosebumps on his body, as if not knowing the cause. Akrurar was speechless because he was immersed in extreme bliss. Bhattathiri worshipped Bhagwan seated besides Akrurar in the chariot and prayed to protect him.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kimu śītalimā mahān jale ya-
-tpulako’sāviti coditena tena |
atiharṣaniruttareṇa sārdhaṃ
rathavāsī pavaneśa pāhi māṃ tvam || 73-10 ||
